assumptions: ASSUMPTION: the VRB price-stage matrix printed 01.01.2022 is applied to the 2026 scenario (ADR-0133 D3).
ASSUMPTION: ticket validity windows are not modelled; every PT trip is priced on its own (D4).
ASSUMPTION: job/semester tickets count as Germany-wide flat; monthly and weekly passes as VRB-network flat (D5).
ASSUMPTION: external local single 370 ct for every non-VRB bus/tram ride (D7).
ASSUMPTION: rail tariff distance = ridden stop distance x 1.0 (D7).
